try_intro: A ten-minute tour of this map, for a reader who knows the mathematics but not Lean. Each step links to the place on the map where it starts.
try_1_head: See the shape of the whole proof
try_1_text: Tap a box, then "Open its parts". Each box is a part of the argument, a group of files, or one Lean file. A line joins two boxes when the upper one uses the lower one.
try_2_head: Go all the way down in one place
try_2_text: One group, "From a one-sided bound to the zeros", opens all the way to the statements Lean checks one by one: its three files hold 37 named statements and definitions. Two of them carry an AI agent's reading: follow the boxes tagged "AI reading" down to them.
try_3_text: The card of the one-sided criterion shows the repository's own comment, the statement as Lean checks it ("Show the Lean statement"), and an AI agent's reading of the statement and its proof ("Show an AI agent's reading").
try_4_text: The prime number theorem for this remainder. Its Lean proof is three steps, because the hard work is in the results it rests on; the reading names them.
try_5_text: The other 35 statements have no reading of ours. Each card has "Copy a prompt for your own AI assistant": paste it into any assistant that can read a public GitHub repository. It asks for the same four parts as our readings, and asks the assistant to say where the Lean text does not show why a step follows. A first one to try: integral_primeRemainder, the transform of the remainder.
try_ask_heading: What we would like to know
try_ask_1: Are the repository's own comments enough to follow a statement, or do they need unpacking?
try_ask_2: Do the two readings add anything you want as a mathematician? What is wrong or missing in them?
try_ask_3: When you checked a line of your assistant's reading against the Lean text, did they agree?
try_ask_4: Which statements would you want read next?
try_tell_text: Tell the person who sent you this link.
try_keep_1: This map and its readings were made by AI agents. No mathematician has checked the readings.
try_keep_2: Nothing here says the proof is correct. The map shows what the Lean files state and how they depend on each other.
try_keep_3: This is a first version. On a phone, a large file may open too small to read at first.
